slots.title: Relevant Standards and Guidance Documents
slots.instruction: Determine which South African and international standards or guidance documents are most relevant for blast-induced ground-vibration monitoring and reporting in a mining or TSF context. Write in flowing paragraphs.

slots.title: Criteria and Reporting Distinctions
slots.instruction: Describe how those sources distinguish structural damage criteria, human perception or comfort criteria, geotechnical effects, and monitoring/reporting requirements. Write in flowing paragraphs.

slots.title: Charge Per Delay and Charge Window Definitions
slots.instruction: Explain how authoritative blasting references define maximum charge per delay, maximum instantaneous charge, and short-delay charge windows. Write in flowing paragraphs.

slots.title: Status of a 9 ms Charge Window
slots.instruction: Assess whether a 9 ms charge window is supported by standards or literature, or whether it should be treated as a project/vendor-specific definition unless project documents say otherwise. Write in flowing paragraphs.

slots.title: Dual-Blast or Multi-Design Events
slots.instruction: Describe how dual-blast or multi-design events should be described when charge and distance must be paired by blast design. Write in flowing paragraphs.

constraints: Write for an English technical report.
Focus on the authority of standards, guidance documents, and charge-window definitions rather than basic definitions of PPV, PPA, component peaks, or scaled distance.
Do not invent a compliance criterion.
